item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00885","case1_error":"Counts only one sandwich instead of two, then evaluates the listed sum as $30.25 instead of $32.25.","case2_error":"Calculates jewelry spending without subtracting the $40 already spent on the sweater.","reason":"The first undercounts purchased units and misadds its expression; the second omits a prior expense when calculating remaining funds.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00886","case1_error":"Answer marker says 300, but the derivation correctly concludes $200 remains.","case2_error":"Uses Luke’s future age instead of his current age in the three-times relationship.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00887","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final number 6186 after correctly setting up the total and division by ten.","case2_error":"Treats Richard as 20 years younger, implying an impossible current age of negative six.","reason":"The first gives an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second reverses the age relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00888","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from rim height instead of adding six inches to establish the required reach.","case2_error":"Subtracts only one school journey from total distance, omitting the return journey.","reason":"The first reverses the direction of a height offset; the second omits a traveled segment.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00889","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 80 minus 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Sets 3x equal to the combined pink-and-orange total, omitting the orange contribution x.","reason":"The first is a numerical evaluation error; the second forms an incorrect equation for the combined total.","judgment":"different"}]}
